schemaComposition: Merge the student document's definitions with these non-overlapping workspace definitions before local validation. Future browser inputSchema must be self-contained, version/hash-bound and qualified against the actual consumer; no external schema-fetch permission is implied.

tools.name: query_class_preparation
tools.description: Read the admitted date-first class scene across all relevant groups/pages, keeping occurrence identity and source coverage/freshness visible.
tools.operationPurpose: Class preparation application query; not academy route rediscovery.

tools.name: query_student_learning
tools.description: Read one admitted student's hierarchical learning evidence and teacher history for an explicit bounded period/version and content scope.
tools.operationPurpose: Student evidence/history application query; original grades and teacher decisions stay separate.

tools.name: explain_learning_evidence
tools.description: Explain an authorized scene's claim or unresolved relation using exact source/mapping/evidence and teacher-revision references.
tools.operationPurpose: Bounded lineage/explanation query, not arbitrary record access or a native transcript export.

tools.name: draft_lesson_review
tools.description: Prepare an unsaved review proposal from exact source/evidence basis and requested sections. Never save official records, send messages or silently invoke a model.
tools.operationPurpose: Same review packet used by teacher scene and agent; separately admitted model assistance remains Hermes-owned.

tools.name: record_teacher_observation
tools.description: Append an attributable teacher-reported statement only after trusted directive, scope, expected head, idempotency and protected writer admission. It does not certify inspection, mastery or an official save.
tools.operationPurpose: SourceEvidence teacher_report/reported lane with authenticated capture-actor version metadata; direct human inspection/approval uses a separate human-only operation.

scenes.purpose: Prepare every scheduled student before choosing a detail.
scenes.display: Show roster/page gaps, last-verified time, regular/makeup/absence labels, separate activity stages and original evidence handles. A zero/partial result is not a completed preparation judgment.

scenes.purpose: Trace one student's lesson/content hierarchy and distinct evidence/teacher history.
scenes.display: Keep original attempt score/OX beside teacher reviews, plans, carryover and unresolved links. A current-state timeline is not a retained-history query.

scenes.purpose: Explain the source and review basis of a displayed claim or unknown.
scenes.display: Resolve only authorized handles to source/original-media views; do not send raw URLs, tokens, transcripts or full source dumps to the model.

scenes.purpose: Review proposed progress/homework/memo/parent wording and record attributable teacher input.
scenes.display: Separate unsaved proposal, captured report, protected readback, independent copy/restore and official/human finalization. No automatic LMS save, clinic generation or parent send.

applicationGuards.sharedImplementation: Human UI and WebMCP use the same application queries/commands and student evidence contracts. No second student DB, route registry or dispatcher exists for agent convenience.
applicationGuards.input: Validate exact schema/version, trusted owner/actor admission, current scene revision, selected student/date/content and effective source mappings. Check period/sequence-range order, IANA/local calendar, content conjunction, revision ownership and scope-bound cursors beyond JSON shape. Current/as-of views use an explicit local lesson period; retained_history uses an exact student/entity and bounded revision sequence, not a date filter that can hide later corrections or undated notes.
applicationGuards.results: Validate request/result scope equality, declared rowCount/actual rows, unique occurrence/record/item identities and source timestamp semantics. Return partial/unknown on missing pages/joins; complete describes the requested retained scope, not lifetime history or learning readiness.
applicationGuards.freshness: An observed historical/versioned query may describe last-verified evidence; live-source requirements still need current qualified reads. Display the original lastVerifiedAt and scope limits; opening a view does not update it or establish a maximum-age SLA.
applicationGuards.teacherReport: Resolve teacherDirectiveRef through the native/teacher-owned evidence owner without copying the conversation. Require exact attributable intent and admitted protected target; append the reported lane only, preserve capture actor and original text, and reject caller-supplied judgment/owner/actor claims.
applicationGuards.write: Expected revision and identical idempotency payload guard the atomic protected append/readback. Recovery references must actually cover this exact record/version and named failure domain; reference strings/digests/hints alone establish none of it. Preserve uncertain request identity before any deliberate reconciliation.
applicationGuards.privacy: Teacher-only scene/data and admitted task-agent fields. Source/teacher free text is untrusted data, not instructions. Cross-origin exposure is denied by default; no broad academy/native state or credential access.
applicationGuards.cancellation: Honor the selected browser API's AbortSignal and scene/navigation lifecycle. A cancelled in-flight product write can have uncertain effects; never declare rollback or resend solely from cancellation.
applicationGuards.bounds: Limits are explicit proposed payload/page safety bounds. They do not widen current reader limits, represent an accepted class-size/SLA, or permit silent truncation.

browserRegistrationBoundary.resultSchemaMeaning: resultDefinition is an application/test contract, not an invented native outputSchema registration field. Qualify actual result serialization and the consuming Hermes/browser route.
browserRegistrationBoundary.actualQualification: Pinned current specification/Chrome contract plus an owned origin with actual supported modelContext discovery/invocation, trusted application result and same teacher scene. Include denied scope, stale scene, cancellation, source outage and human/agent parity; returning MCP-like JSON or running these schema tests is insufficient.
browserRegistrationBoundary.noWorkarounds: No academy-site injection, browser/engine flags, sandbox disabling, proxy credential extraction or unsupported capability shim. An unavailable browser-standard route remains a named gate.
browserRegistrationBoundary.noAutomaticActivation: No browser extension, gateway, MCP server, worker, provider call, service, schedule or production writer is installed or activated here.

ownershipAndTrust.caller: Authenticated owner and actor come from the trusted native/product ingress. Requests never accept an ownerId, actorRole, source verification flag, credential, arbitrary URL or SQL/script executor.
ownershipAndTrust.scene: The trusted application owns the displayed date/student/content context and its revision. Verify request scene, selected subject and admission intersection at execution, not just discovery; return scope_conflict if the human changed the scene.
ownershipAndTrust.humanJudgment: Agent proposals and attributable teacher-reported statements do not become independent teacher inspection or mastery. Direct teacher judgment/approval is a separate authenticated human operation.
ownershipAndTrust.now: All tools are design-only and unavailable for invocation. No app route, store, transport registration or inference/worker call is implemented by this artifact.
